import re from typing import List def find_html_tags(html_string: str) -> List[str]: """ Extract all HTML tags from the given string. The function uses a non-greedy regular expression to match substrings that start with '<', contain any characters except '>' and end with a single '>'. It does not attempt to parse malformed HTML; it simply returns all tag-like substrings. No exceptions are raised for normal input. Parameters: html_string (str): The HTML content to scan. Returns: List[str]: A list of matched tag strings, e.g. ['
', '']. """ # Compile the pattern once to avoid recompilation on each call _tag_pattern = re.compile(r'<[^>]+?>') # Find all non-overlapping matches tags = _tag_pattern.findall(html_string) return tags
